Ananya Varghese
DevOps & SRE Engineer | Delhi NCR
ananya.varghese120@example.com | +91 9718665628

Experienced DevOps and Site Reliability Engineer with hands-on experience building and operating production-grade infrastructure for high-throughput fintech and consumer platforms. Skilled at automating infrastructure, improving deployment cadence, and reducing incident MTTR through observability and runbook automation. Immediate joiner.

Experience
Razorpay, Sep 2025 - Present
DevOps Engineer — Remote

- Automated configuration drift remediation using Ansible playbooks for Linux hosts and application config, decreasing configuration-related incidents by 45%.
- Improved CI/CD pipeline reliability by integrating Docker image security scanning and automated rollbacks, cutting failed deploys in production by 30%.

Pixelwave Studios, Aug 2025 - Aug 2025
Site Reliability Engineer — Onsite
- Led a rapid infrastructure hardening effort using Jenkins pipelines to standardize build and release of containerized game services, reducing build failures by 40%.
- Provisioned ephemeral environments with Terraform and Docker for QA teams, enabling parallel testing that increased release throughput by 25%.
- Created Ansible playbooks for consistent host configuration and Linux kernel tuning for low-latency workloads, improving service p95 latency by 12%.

PhonePe, Sep 2024 - Jul 2025
Site Reliability Engineer — Hybrid
- Managed Kubernetes clusters for payment services, optimizing pod autoscaling and node pools to lower infra costs by 18% while maintaining SLOs.
- Containerized legacy services using Docker and migrated workloads to k8s, reducing service startup time by 60% and simplifying deployments.
- Introduced Linux-based observability improvements and Grafana dashboards to track key indicators, cutting incident detection time by 35%.

Paystack India, Aug 2023 - Aug 2024
Platform Engineer — Hybrid
- Developed microservices in Go and gRPC for internal platform tooling, achieving 4x throughput improvement over prior REST implementations.
- Built and maintained service-to-service communication patterns with gRPC, improving request latency and enabling clearer observability.
- Collaborated with product and SRE teams to integrate services into CI using Docker images and standardized deployment charts.

Projects
- On-call Runbook Automation: Automated common on-call remediation steps using scripts and Ansible runbooks, reducing average on-call time-to-resolution by ~20%.
- Local Dev Kubernetes Toolkit: Created a Docker-based toolkit to replicate production k8s networking and allow developers to run services locally with representative configs.

Observability & Collaboration: Grafana, Jira, Confluence

B.Tech, Computer Engineering, MPSTME NMIMS
